mintAuthority.summary: Two codeless EOAs hold native Etherlink MINTER_ROLE, and the default-admin EOA also controls the transparent proxy administrator. The additional adapter-only minter/burner and satellite representations are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: The complete native RoleGranted/RoleRevoked event census from deployment through Etherlink block 54814410 and pinned hasRole calls identify sole DEFAULT_ADMIN 0x1bb0b2666edd827f74b558136fdbe69e4ecec5fd and three live MINTER_ROLE holders: that EOA, additional codeless EOA 0xab42b550b6d757f3d17eac8e045af095961d75bc, and bridge-only USDSMMinterBurner 0x28da1dfaf5dca1af226a2e56b834e8ec3c495c5a. The verified middleware restricts mint to its one-time-set adapter 0xe7f117f87fa650350c3e363ca2c644951d273d1f, recorded under Bridge Risk rather than native issuance. ProxyAdmin.owner at the same block returns the default-admin EOA, with no mint-logic timelock. Current implementation activation was block 21653650 on July 22, 2025. Public MPC policy and independent reserve-to-liability reconciliation remain unverified; exact role census does not imply human independence or full executable bypass closure. MPC quorum, signer independence and key recovery remain undisclosed for both native EOAs, including 0xab42b550b6d757f3d17eac8e045af095961d75bc. Complete adapter peer/DVN/configuration and executable bypass closure remain unproved in the existing Bridge Risk review. Because that adapter can reach a native token MINTER_ROLE holder, its unresolved executable/authorization closure remains an umbrella mint-path question under calibration v2 despite separate bridge-domain ownership. Independent current reconciliation remains unavailable in Backing; mintAuthority.reconciliation stays unknown. Prudential supervision is independently supported by the ESMA exact Stable mint Ltd LEI/EMI/MFSA authorization row, not the issuer's self-reported reserve ratio or cadence. Verified confidence refers to the complete onchain native controller census and verified native token implementation, not adapter execution, financial or human-independence assurance.
unresolvedQuestions: What is the complete executable, authorization, peer/DVN and upgrade closure of adapter 0xe7f117f87fa650350c3e363ca2c644951d273d1f behind native MINTER_ROLE holder USDSMMinterBurner 0x28da1dfaf5dca1af226a2e56b834e8ec3c495c5a? Verified adapter-only middleware does not prove the upstream adapter's mint reach or bypass exclusion.
